title: Robert Half names DeLynn Senna to Global Executive Director of Permanent Placement

body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif.


, Nov. 3, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Robert Half](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812214-1&h=3022093330&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.roberthalf.com%2Fus%2Fen&a=Robert+Half) (NYSE: RHI) has appointed DeLynn Senna to Global Executive Director of Permanent Placement. In this role, Senna is responsible for leading the company's global Permanent Placement strategy and driving growth across all practice groups and markets.


During her career at Robert Half, Senna has held leadership positions including Executive Director of Finance and Accounting Permanent Placement, Executive Director of Permanent Placement International Staffing, Senior District Director of Robert Half Legal and most recently, Senior District Director of Global Executive Search. Her deep understanding of the company's business, clients and talent markets positions her to advance its global strategy and unlock new opportunities.


"DeLynn's extensive experience, strong leadership and proven ability to drive growth and operational excellence make her ideally suited for this important role," said Paul Gentzkow, President and CEO of Robert Half's Talent Solutions business unit. "Her expertise will help us strengthen global execution, scale proven strategies and capitalize on growth opportunities."


Senna's appointment underscores Robert Half's continued investments in its Permanent Placement business. By bringing a global focus to its operations and sharing proven strategies across geographies, the company aims to grow and deliver greater value to its clients and candidates.


**FAQs**
**What is Robert Half Permanent Placement?**
Robert Half Permanent Placement helps companies strengthen their long-term potential by assisting them in hiring skilled professionals with hard-to-find experience for full-time roles.


**What is DeLynn Senna's new role?**
Senna is Global Executive Director, Permanent Placement, responsible for leading Robert Half's global Permanent Placement strategy and driving growth and performance across markets and practice groups.


**About Robert Half** Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) is the world's first and largest specialized talent solutions and business consulting firm, connecting highly skilled job seekers with rewarding opportunities at great companies. We offer contract talent and full-time solutions in the fields of finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support, and we also provide executive search services.


Robert Half is the parent company of Protiviti®, a global consulting firm that delivers internal audit, risk, business and technology consulting solutions. In the last 12 months, Robert Half has been recognized as one of America's Most Innovative Companies by Fortune and, with Protiviti, has been named a Fortune® Most Admired Company™ and one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For.
